public_findings.snippet: Bitcoin Cash II (BCH2) A Return to Decentralized Mining Through Fair Distribution What is BCH2? BCH2 (Bitcoin Cash II) is a SHA-256 proof-of-work cryptocurrency that forks from BC2 (BitcoinII) at block height 53,200, upgrading to full Bitcoin Cash consensus rules. Every BC2 holder at the fork block receives an equal amount of BCH2 at a 1:1 ratio  no registration, no claims process, no KYC. No premine. No dev fee. No ICO. 100% of new coins go to miners. Estimated mainnet launch: March 79, 2026 Why BC2? BC2 (BitcoinII) deserves credit as a well-executed Bitcoin implementation.
